title: tc-score-summary
description: NPS or CSAT results: the score, the bands, the answers per score, the change and the target.

heading.description: The heading; defaults to "Net Promoter Score" or "Customer satisfaction"

description.description: The line under the heading – the survey and the period

responses.description: Answers per score, lowest score first: 11 for NPS (0–10), 5 for CSAT (1–5)

scores.description: Or the answers themselves, one score each – used when `responses` is empty

previous.description: The score last time, for the change; defaults to the last `trend` point

trend.description: Earlier scores, oldest first – drawn as a sparkline ending at the current score

comparedTo.description: What the change is compared with – "last quarter"; defaults to the last `trend` label, else "last time"

target.description: The score to reach, shown as a marker

selected.description: The picked score. Changed by the user unless a tc-score-select listener calls preventDefault()

labels.description: Words the page can rename, merged over `defaultScoreSummaryLabels`

value.description: The NPS or CSAT for it
